title: Pashley and Trumpauskas retain Under-21 National Cup titles
standfirst: Ella Pashley went through the weekend unbeaten at Highfields in Wellingborough, while Larry Trumpauskas lost once on his way to keeping the men's title.
body: Ella Pashley and Larry Trumpauskas both defended their Under-21 National Cup titles at Highfields TTC in Wellingborough over the weekend.

Pashley did not lose a match. Her final-round meeting with Sophie Earley effectively decided the women's event, with Earley also unbeaten until then, and Pashley won it 3-0. Earley finished second and Anna Green took third after beating Catherine Lv.

The men's event was played as a round robin, and Trumpauskas did his decisive work before the last round. A 3-2 win over Abraham Sellado in round seven put the title beyond his rivals, which meant his only defeat of the weekend, a 3-1 loss to Isaac Kingham in the final round, did not affect the result.
Sellado finished as runner-up, separated from Max Radiven on their head-to-head result, with Radiven taking third.
Both players have now won the event in consecutive years. Over a round-robin weekend, that takes consistency across every match rather than one strong day.

Table Tennis England's junior calendar continues with the Cambridge Junior 4*, which offers a route to the National Championships and supports a disability charity. Entries close later this week. Entries for the Cadet and Girls' Cadet British Clubs Leagues are also closing soon.
